text:
Sam Bennett's night against Buffalo on Nov. 21 was the whole package: a hat trick and an assist in a 4-3 win. On one of the goals, The Athletic's Matthew Fairburn noted, "He had way too much room to meander around Buffalo's zone." That pushed him to 10 goals and 16 points in 24 games, seven of the goals in his last ten.

Our form check is cool on it. The chances in that stretch were normal (2.5 expected goals on his own shots against 2.9 usual), so the run reads as mostly bounces. For the season he has 10 goals on 6.7 expected, shooting 17% against 13% last year, and his ice time has slipped to 16:51 over the last ten.

The rest of his game is steadier than the scoring. Florida takes 54.5% of the expected goals at five on five with him on, 5.3 points better than without him, and he has 50 hits. Evolving-Hockey's warnings from last season were penalties (2.6 goals) and chances against. Watch those two as the shooting comes back toward normal.
